Founder & Accredited Training

Meet Dalia Metrikiene — Master Technician & Educator

With years of competition trophies, hospital-grade hygiene protocols, and loyal Suffolk clients returning month after month, Dalia combines Eastern-European cuticle precision with modern UK clinical technology — alongside hands-on certified training for aspiring nail & beauty technicians.

  • Multi-Award-Winning Studio: From everyday natural BIAB to intricate hand-painted nail architecture.
  • Next-Gen UV Lash & Laser Technology: Longer lash retention, facial skin rejuvenation, body wraps & targeted laser hair removal.
